channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Daryl Morey | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Daryl Morey from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Daryl Morey
item.description:
Nick Nurse on Daryl Morey's departure:

“Obviously I really enjoyed working with Daryl. I really did day-to-day and all that kind of stuff was very enjoyable. But it's a decision that's been made and now we got to move on from it. I wish him the best. Always have a fondness for Daryl. But Mike's here and he's in charge now and my job is to get this team better every day and that's what we're going to do.”

Nick Nurse on Daryl Morey, Jun 24, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jared McCain on Daryl Morey
item.description:
Michael Scotto:Jared McCain on Daryl Morey trading him:

“It’s never to prove anybody wrong. I try to keep a positive outlook. I like proving my support system right. Daryl’s still the guy that drafted me, so I’ll always have love for him for that. He believed in me enough to take me at No. 16.”

Jared McCain on Daryl Morey, May 23, 2026. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Josh Harris on Daryl Morey
item.description:
Josh Harris:

“Tuesday was a difficult day for me. I consider Daryl Morey a friend, and he did a lot of positive things for our franchise. Made the playoffs five or six years, including the conference semifinals.”

Josh Harris on Daryl Morey, May 14, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Daryl Morey, Jared McCain
item.description:
OKC Thunder head coach Mark Daigneault on the Jared McCain trade:

“I'm not involved in the trades. So I'm not going to make comments on the acquisitions. I do know I have high respect for Philadelphia, their decision-making process, their group. I know that transactions are to be evaluated in a sequence. They aren't to be evaluated in a vacuum. They are set up by previous transactions, they set up future transactions. It's hard to evaluate those things in a vacuum. You never know what a team is planning and how that fits in. That's why our group, Sam and his guys and Daryl Morey and his guys do their due diligence and work the league around the deadline. That's why all this happens. But I do have great respect for their front office.”

Mark Daigneault on Daryl Morey, Jared McCain, Mar 23, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Draymond Green on Daryl Morey
item.description:
“It’s ridiculous. So now we want to add a four point shot or who knows what. No, can we stop trying to completely rewrite the game of basketball because Daryl Morey came up with a theory that ultimately wasn’t successful for him?”

Draymond Green on Daryl Morey, Mar 10, 2026. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Kendrick Perkins on Daryl Morey
item.description:
Recently, former NBA player turned analyst Kendrick Perkins spoke on the state of affairs between Harden and the Sixers on ESPN's show First Take, and the big man did not mince words.

“Here's the thing. The best case is for Daryl Morey and the Philadelphia 76ers to do exactly what they just did: Tell him to stay home,”

Kendrick Perkins on Daryl Morey, Oct 28, 2023. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Oubre Jr. on Daryl Morey, Nick Nurse
item.description:
As Oubre Jr. prepares for his first season in Philadelphia, he spoke on why he signed with the Sixers and what he likes about the team.

“It was, obviously, late in the free agency period and I was really taking this offseason to kind of dial my life in and reenergize and refocus and Mr. (Daryl) Morey and coach Nick (Nurse), they were constantly trying to get in contact with me,”

Oubre Jr. on Daryl Morey, Nick Nurse, Oct 2, 2023. Source: Sixers Wire.

item.title: Channing Frye on Daryl Morey, James Harden
item.description:
Channing Frye on the James Harden-Daryl Morey situation:

“I feel like it's some petty sh*it--- I feel like it's bullsh*t. Like a guy that's demanded six different trades demands this and now starts talking shit about the guy. If they were trying to trade you and you don't have equal value, will you think you're just gonna bully your way out? He's not a top 10 player in the league right now,right?”

Channing Frye on Daryl Morey, James Harden, Aug 20, 2023. Source: YouTube.

item.title: James Harden on Daryl Morey
item.description:
Shams Charania:James Harden:

“Daryl Morey is a liar and I will never be a part of an organization that he’s a part of. Let me say that again: Daryl Morey is a liar and I will never be a part of an organization that he’s a part of.”

James Harden on Daryl Morey, Aug 14, 2023. Source: Twitter @ShamsCharania.

item.title: Chris Paul on Daryl Morey
item.description:
C.J. Paul told Yahoo Sports.

“Daryl Morey said he wasn’t going to trade Chris. Think about that. And now he’s going to the Finals on a team that three and four years ago he never would have played at. We thought Houston was going to be the last stop, and now it’s been two more stops. We’re just enjoying this, and I’m just happy for Chris.”

Chris Paul on Daryl Morey, Jul 1, 2021. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Josh Harris on Daryl Morey
item.description:
Josh Harris on Daryl Morey:

“Talent like Daryl rarely becomes available... He has an extraordinary track record of success in this league as an innovator, visionary and leader. I believe he significantly improves our chances of delivering a championship caliber team to our fans.”

Josh Harris on Daryl Morey, Nov 2, 2020. Source: Twitter @brianseltzer.

item.title: Josh Harris on Daryl Morey
item.description:
Josh Harris on recruiting Daryl Morey to Sixers:

“The minute that he was leaving Houston, we jumped on it and we've been watching his achievements over many years.”

Josh Harris on Daryl Morey, Nov 2, 2020. Source: Twitter @brianseltzer.

item.title: Tilman Fertitta on Daryl Morey
item.description:
Fertitta continued:

“Daryl Morey's job is safe. I'm sure he's going to pick the right head coach.”

Tilman Fertitta on Daryl Morey, Sep 15, 2020. Source: Twitter @Jonathan_Feigen.

item.title: Tilman Fertitta on Daryl Morey
item.description:
Tilman Fertitta:

“The tweet was seven words. There was nothing wrong with the tweet. That’s why one hour later I told ESPN when I was asked ‘Are you going to get rid of Daryl Morey,’ I was like, ‘Are you crazy? Why would I get rid of Daryl for that tweet?’I think Daryl’s one of the best general managers in the league. Plus, we truly enjoy working with each other. To this day, we plan on working with each other and I expect Daryl to be here for years to come.”

Tilman Fertitta on Daryl Morey, Jun 6, 2020. Source: Houston Chronicle.

item.title: Shane Battier on Daryl Morey, Sam Hinkie
item.description:
Rockets general manager Daryl Morey deserves a share of the credit.

“I was lucky to play for Daryl Morey and Sam Hinkie, who taught me how to look at the data,”

Shane Battier on Daryl Morey, Sam Hinkie, May 16, 2020. Source: Sports Illustrated.

item.title: Chris Paul on Daryl Morey
item.description:
“They said we’re not trying to go in a different direction. [Morey] asked me if I wanted to go to Oklahoma City. I said no, and he said, ‘We won’t trade you there, because you chose to come to us from L.A.’ He doesn’t owe me anything, but that’s where the whole communication thing was.”

Chris Paul on Daryl Morey, Jan 22, 2020. Source: Sports Illustrated.

item.title: Charles Barkley on Daryl Morey
item.description:
TNT’s Charles Barkley on Rockets GM Daryl Morey:

“Why should LeBron sacrifice his money because of some tweet this fool put out? Why should the NBA sacrifice their billions? ... When you work for a company, you speak for the entire company. ... We’re not going to change China.”

Charles Barkley on Daryl Morey, Oct 24, 2019. Source: Twitter @BenGolliver.

item.title: Shaquille O'Neal on Daryl Morey
item.description:
O’Neal on TNT:

“We as American people, we do a lot of business in China. And they know and understand our values. And we understand their values. And one of our best values here in America is free speech. We’re allowed to say what we want to say, and we’re allowed to speak up about injustices, and that’s just how it goes. And if people don’t understand that, that’s something that they have to deal with. But I just think it was unfortunate for both parties. And then you’ve got people speaking when they don’t know what they’re talking about. But Daryl Morey was right. Whenever you see something wrong going on anywhere in the world, you should have the right to say, “That’s not right,”

Shaquille O'Neal on Daryl Morey, Oct 24, 2019. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Joe Harris on Daryl Morey
item.description:
Joe Harris on whether or not he is worried about the financial implications of Daryl Morey’s tweets:

“I already get paid too much to play a game. So, not really.”

Joe Harris on Daryl Morey, Oct 16, 2019. Source: Twitter @malika_andrews.

item.title: LeBron James on Daryl Morey
item.description:
Lakers’ LeBron James on NBA’s China controversy:

“I don’t want to get into a ... feud with Daryl Morey but I believe he wasn’t educated on the situation at hand and he spoke.”

LeBron James on Daryl Morey, Oct 15, 2019. Source: Twitter @BenGolliver.

item.title: LeBron James on Daryl Morey
item.description:
“I don't want to get into a [verbal] feud with Daryl Morey, but I believe he wasn't educated on the situation at hand, and he spoke,”

LeBron James on Daryl Morey, Oct 15, 2019. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Tilman Fertitta on Daryl Morey
item.description:
Fertitta says, his voice rising.

“Did I say I don't want to be in the f---ing tax one out of three years, I don't want to get in the repeater tax? Absolutely. OK, but I would have spent whatever this past year if [Morey] would have said, 'I can get this player, and this guy's going to help us win a championship.'”

Tilman Fertitta on Daryl Morey, Jun 17, 2019. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Daryl Morey, Jeff Bzdelik
item.description:
Mark Berman:Mike D'Antoni on Jeff Bzdelik no longer on the coaching staff:

“I thought Jeff and everybody under him did a great job.. You'd have to ask (GM) Daryl (Morey) about the reasoningand all that behind it, but there are some great coaches out there.”

Mike D'Antoni on Daryl Morey, Jeff Bzdelik, May 24, 2019. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: Raymond Brothers on Daryl Morey, Danuel House
item.description:
AgentRaymond Brothers on @Danuel House returning to the #Rockets for the rest of the season:

“I'm thanking Daryl Morey and the Rockets for trying to work out a long-term deal. We'll revisit it in the summer.”

Raymond Brothers on Daryl Morey, Danuel House, Mar 12, 2019. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: Austin Rivers on Mike D'Antoni, Daryl Morey
item.description:
Salman Ali:Austin Rivers:

“As much as you hear about how much freedom Mike (D'Antoni) gives...you don't really understand it to you're here playing for them just how much fun this team has on the floor.... It's a great environment that Daryl (Morey) and coach (D'Antoni) have created.”

Austin Rivers on Mike D'Antoni, Daryl Morey, Jan 12, 2019. Source: Twitter @RedNationHoops.

item.title: RJ Hunter on Daryl Morey
item.description:
Hunter said of summer league play.

“I don’t want to put too much stock in this. I just try to take it possession by possession and try to get better.“Me and (Rockets general manager) Daryl Morey had a real good conversation after the season. He just told me what I have to work on and kind of what they’re looking for from the wing position. All I can really do is focus on getting better and competing every game.”

RJ Hunter on Daryl Morey, Jul 11, 2018. Source: Houston Chronicle.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Daryl Morey, Trevor Ariza
item.description:
They are an unconscionable 34-1 when Harden, Paul and Clint Capela play together.

“We respect the hell out of them. We respect all those guys and we know — you hear a lot from their GM [Daryl Morey] — but James, and CP and Trevor Ariza, those guys knuckle down and play. They leave the talking up to the GM and whoever else,”

Kevin Durant on Daryl Morey, Trevor Ariza, Mar 8, 2018. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Chris Paul on Daryl Morey
item.description:
Kevin Durant the Rockets trading for Chris Paul:

“I'm not surprised by anything, but it was kind of like 'Hmm. Damn, that's a smart move. I wouldn't think anybody would be that smart to pull that off.' I think it was a great move. You put two guys together that are crafty with the ball, they're going to get everybody shots and they going to get each other shots. It was a ballsy move to pull off by [Rockets GM Daryl] Morey. I don't think anybody would have thought to do that.”

Chris Paul on Daryl Morey, Aug 28, 2017. Source: CSNBayArea.com.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Daryl Morey
item.description:
Mark Berman:Mike D'Antoni:

“Daryl Morey does an unbelievable job. I'm happy to be able to hopefully assist in it & be a part of it & try to get the job done”

Mike D'Antoni on Daryl Morey, May 31, 2016. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: Bob Myers on Daryl Morey
item.description:
Bob Myers on Daryl Morey:

“He’s fantastic. I’ve learned from him, the way that he does things. I don’t think he gets enough credit for what he did with their roster this year.”

Bob Myers on Daryl Morey, May 23, 2015. Source: Houston Chronicle.
